We are sorry to inform you that we have identified a risk issue with the skill package. This issue has been fixed, but the skill package will no longer receive future updates or support. Please visit https://clawhub.ai/plugins/crusheart-autobrain-turbo for the latest version.
Major refactor and content update for crusheart-performance-autobrain v6.3.1:

- Migrated to a new architecture with 90+ Python engines, organized into distinct engine groups and subsystems.
- Significantly restructured file layout: core modules removed, new bundle and documentation files added.
- Expanded and detailed SKILL.md with up-to-date features, install instructions, architecture diagrams, and resource links.
- Enhanced plugin slot logic and added auto-scan, auto-save, and maintenance task scripts.
- Updated and localized documentation, including English and Chinese guides.

**Changelog for crusheart-performance-autobrain v5.2.1**

- Marked this skill package as no longer maintained; users are directed to https://clawhub.ai/plugins/crusheart-autobrain-turbo for future updates.
- Verified file integrity.
- Bug fixes and improved response speed.
- Major refactor: Replaced and reorganized old files, expanding `core/` engine modules.
- Added comprehensive documentation and reference files (`IDENTITY.md`, `TOOLS.md`, etc.).
- Installation and upgrade scripts enhanced for compatibility and full-path validation.

灵枢 AutoBrain v5.2.0

- Documentation files (README.md, SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, config and metadata) now reflect v5.2.0 and are organized under the new directory.
- Skill description, capabilities, upgrade instructions, and architecture overview updated to v5.2.0 throughout documentation.

- 增加统一版 README.md，提供更清晰的安装与说明文档入口
- 保持功能与安装方式一致，兼容原有自动升级与回滚机制

**灵枢 AutoBrain v5.1.2 — 架构大幅升级，精简包体结构，优化兼容与运维体验。**

- 全新架构：引擎层级与架构文档重组，新增 ARCHITECTURE.md，工具与脚本体系更完善
- 兼容升级：支持无缝从 v5.0.x / v5.1.x 自动升级，升级/回滚机制完善（自动备份、废弃文件清理、配置迁移）
- 引擎优化：新增/替换引擎与工具（如 iron_rules.py, trace_timeline.py, execution_audit.py），移除过时模块（如 user_digital_twin, daemon_manager, decision_quality 等）
- 自动化脚本扩展：补充安装、校验、复盘、索引、热插拔支持相关脚本
- SKILL 信息与包结构规范化，新增类别，统一命名、描述、多语言兼容，文档

🎯 中文名「灵枢」，面向个人用户的长期运行 AI 中枢
📦 自包含安装，引擎文件内嵌 bundle，即装即用
🔌 兼容层 PluginSDK：CompatEngine / CompatRegistry / CompatScaffold
🔧 第三方引擎热插拔支持（plugins/*/plugin.json 自动扫描注册）
🔐 身份漂移守卫 — 防止人格/规则偏离
🧠 用户动态画像 — 自动提取用户偏好
🔄 会话交接 — 静默胶囊，无缝恢复
⚖️ JudgeEngine — LLM-as-Judge 自评分 + Reflexion 反思
🩺 模型故障转移 — 主模型挂后自动切换
